overall_design: Treat the London car‑rental reservation as a prerequisite for finalizing the Paris dinner suggestion. The Paris dinner email explicitly requires the car rental to be sorted first because Pierre needs it for his London summit trip. A separate email from Mark Black independently requests the same reservation for the summit, and a London conference‑hotel email reinforces the requirement as part of travel logistics. Each site adapts the core action to its local carrier without duplicating language.
